choices.content: The zero vector is collinear with any vector
It is collinear only with the zero vector

question.prompt: According to the definition of collinearity, how is the zero vector related to any vector?

solutions.explanation: Taking \(\lambda=0\) gives \(0=\lambda a\). The textbook treats the zero vector as collinear with any vector.
solutions.title: Zero scalar multiple and collinearity convention
